The company's product portfolio includes aluminum windows, doors, curtain walls, cladding, and various glazing systems such as structural glazing, unitized glazing, and spider glazing, along with aluminum composite panels, skylights, and canopies.

ANDHRAPAP.NS.d: Andhra Paper Limited manufactures, sells, and exports paper and pulp products in India and internationally. The company offers writing, printing, copier, and specialty paper products; paperboards; and cut-size paper products, such as office documentation and multipurpose papers.

ANKITMETAL.NS.d: Ankit Metal & Power Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel products in India. The company offers iron ore pillets, sponge iron, M.S. billets, TMT bars, pig iron, and ferro silicon. It serves real estate developers, construction units, forging units, wire drawing units, railways, and engineering industries. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Kolkata, India.

ASKAUTOLTD.NS.d: ASK Automotive Limited, founded in 1988 and headquartered in Gurugram, makes and distributes automotive components in India through its subsidiary. Its products include braking systems such as brake shoes, disc pads and liners, and lightweight aluminum precision parts for two-wheelers, four-wheelers and electric vehicles. It also produces safety control cables, including brake, clutch and throttle cables.

AUSOMENT.NS.d: Ausom Enterprise Limited engages in the trading activities in India. It trades in commodities, bullions, gold jewelry, shares and securities, diamonds, derivatives, and units of mutual funds. The company was formerly known as Core Emballage Limited. Ausom Enterprise Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

BEEKAY.NS.d: Beekay Steel Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of iron and steel products, including TMT bars, billets, and sponge iron; the company is based in Kolkata, India. They cater to the construction and infrastructure sectors. Their business model revolves around producing and selling steel products in the domestic market.

BYKE.NS.d: The Byke Hospitality Limited owns, operates, and manages hotels and resorts in India. It operates 20 properties with a capacity of 1,190 rooms and 145 rooms under management contract under the The Byke brand. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

CENTEXT.NS.d: Century Extrusions Limited manufactures and sells aluminum extruded and value added products in India. It provides profiles for architectural applications, such as building systems, structural glazing, curtain walls, aluminum rolling shutters, windows, doors, partitions, false ceilings, tower bolts, hand rails, door handles, hinges, drapery rods, modular furniture, etc.; aluminum form works; road transport sections; rail coach windows and doors; manufacture of automobile components; and heat transfer in…

CRIZAC.NS.d: Crizac Limited operates a technology-enabled B2B platform for international education services in India and abroad. It offers student recruitment solutions to universities and colleges in the UK, Canada, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and the United Arab Emirates. Incorporated in 2011, it is based in Kolkata.

DABUR.NS.d: Dabur India Limited operates as a fast moving consumer goods company worldwide. It operates through Consumer Care Business, Foods Business, and Others segments. The company manufactures and sells health supplements under the Dabur Chyawanprash, Dabur Honey, and Dabur Glucose brands; digestive products under the Dabur Hajmola, Pudin Hara, Hingoli, Dabur Nature Care, and Sat Isabgol brands; and shampoos under the Dabur Almond and Vatika brands.

DIGIDRIVE.NS.d: Digidrive Distributors Limited, with its affiliate Open Media Network Private Limited, sells consumer goods through online retail channels in India. It has Trading and Publication segments, and the Trading division distributes Carvaan, a portable digital music player.

DYNAMATECH.NS.d: Dynamatic Technologies Limited manufactures and sells engineered products to the aerospace, automotive, and hydraulic industries in India and internationally. The company operates through Hydraulics, Aerospace and Defense, and Others segments. The Hydraulics segment offers hydraulic gear pumps, torque motors, hand pumps, hitch control valves, rock shaft assemblies, lube and water pumps, mobile control valves, orbitrols, and hydraulic solutions.

FLFL.NS.d: Future Lifestyle Fashions Limited operates as an integrated fashion company in India. It primarily operates a chain of retail format stores under the Central name; and fashion discount stores under the Brand Factory name. The company's stores offer men's formals, casuals, youth wear, women's western wear, women's ethnic, sportswear, denim wear, infant wear, accessories, footwear, luggage, and others; and cosmetics, fragrances, eyewear, watches, accessories, sportswear, toys, mobiles, electronics, home, and others.

GIRRESORTS.NS.d: GIR Natureview Resorts Limited provides services related to hospitality, travel, and leisure sectors in India. The company plans and executes small to medium hospitality projects primarily for service apartments, small hotels, and resorts, as well as renovates and redesigns existing hotels, resorts, or service apartments.

GOPAL.NS.d: Gopal Snacks Limited produces and distributes snacks internationally, covering traditional Indian savouries such as namkeen, gathiya and papad as well as Western-style snacks. Its range also includes wafers, extruded snacks, snack pellets, spices, gram flour and noodles, together with sweets from India like chikki and soan papdi.

HINDALCO.NS.d: Hindalco Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells aluminum and copper products in India and internationally. It operates through Aluminium, Copper, Novelis, and All Other Segments.

HYBRIDFIN.NS.d: Hybrid Financial Services Limited, established in Mumbai in 1986, and its subsidiaries provide advisory and financial services mainly in India. Its work centres on management consultancy, including debt recovery guidance and advice on tax, legal, commercial, secretarial and financial matters.

IL&FSENGG.NS.d: IL&FS Engineering and Construction Company Limited, based in Hyderabad, handles infrastructure development, construction and project management in India and abroad. Its projects include roads, bridges, expressways and railways, residential, commercial, industrial and hospital buildings, and works for the energy and utilities sectors.

INTLCONV.NS.d: International Conveyors Limited (ICL) and its affiliates make and distribute PVC conveyor belting worldwide. It has four divisions: Conveyor Belting, Wind Energy, Trading Goods and Investment. Its fire-resistant and anti-static belts carry materials such as coal and potash.

MANAKSIA.NS.d: Manaksia Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells metal products in India and internationally. The company offers sponge iron and value added steel products comprising cold rolled sheets used in interior and exterior panels of automobiles, buses, and commercial vehicles; galvanised corrugated sheets used in the rural housing sector and factory buildings; galvanised plain sheets used in the manufacture of containers and water tanks; and colour coated (pre-painted) coils and sheets for sale to…

MBECL.NS.d: McNally Bharat Engineering Company Limited primarily engages in engineering, procurement, and construction businesses in India. It operates through two segments, Turnkey Engineering and Other Engineering Services.

MEGASTAR.NS.d: Megastar Foods Limited, set up in 2011, with its head office in Chandigarh, is a food processor producing wheat flour products at scale across India. Its range includes chokar, rawa, suji, wheat flour and atta, together with organic options such as organic atta and organic whole wheat flour.

MLKFOOD.NS.d: Milkfood Limited is an Indian company engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of dairy products. The company produces various products, including ghee, butter, milk powder, and cheese. The company is located in India.

MOLBIO.NS.d: Molbio Diagnostics Limited works in point-of-care diagnostics, supplying technologies for diagnosing infectious diseases and non-communicable ones. The company produces diagnostic devices built on chips, sold with chips and reagents, X-ray equipment and detectors, along with disposable tests for dengue, malaria and COVID-19 and portable tabletop analysers.

NBIFIN.NS.d: N.B.I. Industrial Finance Company Limited, a non-banking financial company, invests in shares, securities, and other financial activities. The company was formerly known as The New Bank of India Limited and changed its name to N.B.I. Industrial Finance Company Limited in May 1951. N.B.I. Industrial Finance Company Limited was incorporated in 1936 and is based in Kolkata, India.

PRESTIGE.NS.d: Prestige Estates Projects Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, construction, and leasing of real estate properties in India. The company develops a range of residential projects, including townships, apartments, luxury villas, mansions, row houses, town homes and golf developments; commercial projects comprising office spaces, built-to-suit campuses, special economic zones, and IT parks; and retail properties, such as malls.

PRIMO.NS.d: Primo Chemicals Limited, headquartered in Chandigarh and established in 1975, makes and distributes chemicals in India. Its products include bleaching powder, hydrogen gas, sodium hypochlorite, aluminium chloride, liquid chlorine, hydrochloric acid and caustic soda in lye and flake form.

RAJSREESUG.NS.d: Rajshree Sugars and Chemicals Limited engages in the sugar, power, distillery, and biotechnology businesses in India. It provides white crystal sugar, demerara sugar, white sugar sachets, and demerara sugar sachets. The company also offers distillery products, such as rectified spirit, anhydrous alcohol, and extra neutral alcohol; and organic manure. In addition, it generates power through cogeneration plants. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Coimbatore, India.

RUCHINFRA.NS.d: Ruchi Infrastructure Limited engages in trading of various commodities in India. It operates through Trading, Infrastructure, and Others segments. The company also engages in handling bulk storage of liquid commodities, including edible oils, petroleum products, liquid bulk chemicals, etc.; and operates warehousing facilities for storing agricultural commodities, such as wheat, maize, soybean etc.

SAMBHV.NS.d: Sambhv Steel Tubes Ltd. makes and sells steel products for the Indian market, mainly ERW pipes and structural tubes and stainless-steel coils. Founded in 2017 in Raipur, it offers hot-rolled, cold rolled and galvanized mild steel coils, rectangular, round and square tubes, steel door frames and galvanized products.

SCHAND.NS.d: S Chand and Company Limited, an education content company, develops and delivers content, solutions, and services for the early learning, K-12, and higher education segments in India.

SERVOTECH.NS.d: Servotech Renewable Power System Limited produces and sells LED lights, solar power products and electric vehicle chargers, in India and overseas. Its LED range includes tube lights, streetlights, flood lights, bay lights, bulbs and downlights, and it also offers oxygen concentrators and solar products.

SHALPAINTS.NS.d: Shalimar Paints Limited engages in manufacturing, selling, and distributing paints and coatings in India. The company offers decorative paints for interior and exterior surfaces; industrial paints; marine paints, including antifouling paints; packaging coatings for metal decoration; and emulsions, distempers, primers, putty, enamels, varnishes, and lacquers.

SKIL.NS.d: SKIL Infrastructure Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the infrastructure development business in India. It develops various projects, such as seaports, logistics, railways, defense shipyards, offshore asset construction yards, special economic zones, and smart cities in the private sector. The company was formerly known as Horizon Infrastructure Limited and changed its name to SKIL Infrastructure Limited in January 2014.

TTML.NS.d: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited provides wireline voice, data, and managed telecom services to enterprise customers in Maharashtra and Goa, India. The company provides its wireline and broadband services under the Tata Tele Business Services brand name.

UGROCAP.NS.d: UGRO Capital Limited is a non-banking financial company in Mumbai that mainly provides lending. It finances businesses in sectors including healthcare, education, chemicals, food processing, hospitality, electrical equipment, auto components and light engineering. Founded in 1993 as Chokhani Securities Limited, it took its present name in September 2018.

VMART.NS.d: V-Mart Retail Limited operates a chain of value retail departmental stores in India. The company's stores offer a range of products, including apparels, home furnishings, toys, footwear, accessories, and general merchandise for men, women, boys, girls, and infants, as well as kirana, tableware, utensils, and other home utility items. As of April 2, 2021, the company operated a network of 279 stores. The company also offers its products online.
